name: Radiohead

whyMatters.en: Abingdon five-piece that moved from UK alternative hits to OK Computer (1997) and Kid A (2000) studio mutation while keeping a stable lineup.
whyMatters.zh: 阿宾登五人组：从英国 alternative 热单走到 OK Computer（1997）与 Kid A（2000）的录音室变异，且阵容保持稳定。

note.en: Multi-section form: prog ambition on alt radio.
note.zh: 多段结构：prog 野心进入 alternative 电台。

note.en: Piano/alienation center of OK Computer era.
note.zh: OK Computer 时期钢琴/疏离核心。

note.en: Kid A opener: electronics before guitar comfort.
note.zh: Kid A 开场：电子先于吉他舒适区。

interviewQuotes.text: Anyone who uses the word 'career' and 'music' in the same sentence should be shot.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Thom Yorke

interviewQuotes.text: We want to make music that surprises us.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jonny Greenwood

lyricQuotes: I'm not here, this isn't happening
For a minute there, I lost myself

shortBio.en: Yorke / Greenwood–era alternative; Paranoid Android and Kid A mark structure then rupture.
shortBio.zh: Yorke / Greenwood 时期 alternative；Paranoid Android 与 Kid A 标记结构与断裂。

body.en:
Formed 1985 (On a Friday). Pablo Honey and The Bends establish guitar-band craft; OK Computer expands multi-section songs and digital anxiety themes; Kid A/Amnesiac foreground electronics and jazz rhythm sections.

Paranoid Android (1997) and Everything in Its Right Place (2000) show prog length inside alternative, then the deliberate dismantling of hit-guitar comfort.
body.zh:
1985 年组建（曾用名 On a Friday）。Pablo Honey 与 The Bends 确立吉他乐队工艺；OK Computer 扩展多段体与数字焦虑主题；Kid A/Amnesiac 突出电子与爵士节奏组。

Paranoid Android（1997）与 Everything in Its Right Place（2000）展示 alternative 内的 prog 时长，以及有意拆除热门吉他舒适区。

body.en:
Radiohead matter as a method: hit capability first, then refuse to freeze the method. Same five people; catalogs that change tools.

Post-1997 rock can mutate without leaving the festival poster.
body.zh:
Radiohead 要紧处是方法：先具备打热单的能力，再拒绝冻结方法。同一五人；更换工具的目录。

1997 年后摇滚可以变异而不离开音乐节海报。

body.en:
Rare among peers: lineup barely churns. Person hubs (Yorke solo/Atoms for Peace) branch sideways instead of replacing the band.

Versions are albums and approaches, not singer swaps.
body.zh:
同辈中少见：阵容几乎不更替。人物枢纽（Yorke 独唱/Atoms for Peace）侧向分支，而非替换乐队。

版本是专辑与方法，不是换主唱。

body.en:
Multi-section song on alternative radio—prog ambition without costume rock. Dynamic cuts and guitar orchestration replace verse-chorus comfort.

Length and form are the attitude.
body.zh:
alternative 电台上的多段体——有 prog 野心而无戏服摇滚。动态切割与吉他配器取代主副歌舒适区。

时长与形式即态度。

title.en: Kid A: remove the hit-guitar costume
title.zh: Kid A：拆掉热门吉他戏服

body.en:
Onodes and processed piano open the album; guitars recede. Jazz players and electronics enter the session picture.

Commercial risk is documented; the musical claim is tool change inside a famous brand.
body.zh:
音序与处理后的钢琴打开专辑；吉他后退。爵士乐手与电子进入录音图景。

商业风险有文献；音乐主张是在著名品牌内部更换工具。

body.en:
Odd forms and texture obsession sit beside UK indie infrastructure and US alternative charts. Influence shows in 2000s art-rock and electronic-adjacent guitar bands.

Passport stamps: both underground credibility and arena dates.
body.zh:
奇数形式与纹理偏执，旁靠英国 indie 基建与美国 alternative 榜。影响见于 2000 年代 art-rock 与电子邻近的吉他乐队。

护照戳：地下信誉与体育场档期并存。

title.zh: 记录在案的反职业话术

body.en:
Press excerpts about refusing the rock-star ladder sit beside meticulous touring and catalog control.

Useful as evidence of branding posture, checked against the release schedule.
body.zh:
关于拒绝摇滚明星阶梯的媒体摘句，旁靠精密巡演与目录控制。

可作品牌姿态证据，对照发行日程核验。

note.zh: 少见的稳定——人物项目侧向分支。

note.en: Early alt-radio hit before the mutation arc.
note.zh: 变异弧线之前的早期 alt 电台热单。

note.en: After OK Computer, mutation stays inside a mass rock brand.
note.zh: OK Computer 之后，变异留在大众摇滚品牌内部。
